title: Emmy Noether: Modern LaTeX Working Corpus and Multilingual Translation Drafts (R823 Source Control and Synchronized Components)
version: 2026-07-17 v26/R823 source control and synchronized components
description:
This is the reader-facing Emmy Noether working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version fronts 00_Noether_German_Cumulative_Working_SourceControl_v26_R823_20260717.pdf, a 466-page German working reader. Its editable TeX, direct source witnesses, before/after renders, audit records, and build transcripts are grouped in file 07.

German R823 change: Paper 20 printed pages 27-31 were reopened directly against the GDZ article witness. R823 restores the source run-in quotient and binomial-count prose, removes a non-source display gap, restores two em-dash parentheticals, and restores equation (14) punctuation. No OCR text was promoted.

New synchronized components: file 09_Noether_R823_SourceSynchronized_Multilingual_Components_20260717.zip contains source-synchronized standalone English components for Papers 10, 20, 26, 28, 29, and 37; bounded R823-controlled Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean outputs for Papers 26 and 36; and the R823 lecture-book title/introduction in Ukrainian, Russian, Interslavic Latin, and Interslavic Cyrillic. Each component carries its own source, build, terminology, visual-QA, and checksum evidence where available.

Open work: the retained full English reader is the older RA10 working branch; the full Chinese and Japanese readers have not been rebased unit by unit to R823; Korean coverage is currently limited to bounded notices; and the Slavic book-front component is 1 of 32 core book units. The previously published Paper 06 Slavic tranche remains a working translation requiring fresh line-by-line reconciliation.

Status caveat: this is a serious source-repair and translation working corpus, not a critical edition, author-wide or paper-by-paper source-faithfulness certification, synchronized multilingual corpus, native-language approval, or publication-grade proofreading. Local task words such as COMPLETE, closed, or ready refer only to bounded components.

GitHub: corrections, source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, and translation improvements can be suggested via issues or pull requests at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first public surface with the v26/R823 German working source-control head and bounded R823-synchronized multilingual components. The retained cumulative translations remain unsynchronized working readers. Not a critical edition or complete multilingual synchronization.
